def build_agent(sandbox):
    return sandbox.get_cart_body()

def agent_action(sandbox, cart, step_count):
    # Get sensor readings
    theta = sandbox.get_pole_angle()
    omega = sandbox.get_pole_angular_velocity()
    x = sandbox.get_cart_position()
    v = sandbox.get_cart_velocity()
    target_x = sandbox.TRACK_CENTER_X
    safe_half_range = sandbox.SAFE_HALF_RANGE

    # Control gains (tuned for new actuator limits and tighter track)
    Kp_theta = 30.0      # Proportional gain for pole angle
    Kd_omega = 10.0      # Derivative gain for angular velocity
    Kp_x = 10.0          # Proportional gain for cart position error
    Kd_v = 5.0           # Derivative gain for cart velocity

    # Compute the control force using PD control
    force = -Kp_theta * theta - Kd_omega * omega - Kp_x * (x - target_x) - Kd_v * v

    # Clamp force within actuator limits
    lim = 0.5
    force = max(-lim, min(lim, force))

    # Apply maximum force if near the edge of the safe zone
    margin = 0.05  # 5cm from edge
    if x < (target_x - safe_half_range + margin):
        force = lim  # Push right
    elif x > (target_x + safe_half_range - margin):
        force = -lim  # Push left

    sandbox.apply_cart_force(force)
